axes.decision: Missing individual values across nested models

levels.description: Complete cases for each model’s required variables
levels.label: uncertain

levels.description: Common complete-case sample within each reported outcome/window family
levels.label: uncertain

levels.description: Retain required status control and leave unavailable early-year values unresolved pending sourcing

axes.decision: Order of polynomial construction and standardization

levels.description: Square raw leave, standardize raw linear and raw squared terms separately; centered age squared
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: All survey-level variables standardized plus inclusion of square supports this reading; operation order unstated.

levels.description: Square standardized leave; retain linear/squared main effects and both matching female interactions
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: For fixed scaling constants and full lower-order polynomial/interactions, this is an invertible basis change with identical fitted linear predictors. Coefficient targets require algebraic mapping; this does not license selecting by agreement.

levels.description: Center age-square again after constructing it
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: With an intercept, shifting a squared regressor by a constant changes the intercept only. Interpretations/targets must be transformed consistently.

levels.description: Eligible country-year records with each survey counted once
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Variables are survey-level; no reference distribution or weights specified.

levels.description: Pooled individual rows for calculating scale constants, implicitly weighting country-years by respondent count
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: For an unchanged estimation sample and complete polynomial/interaction basis, different fixed centering/scaling constants are invertible transformations. Fits are unchanged, but coefficient targets must be transformed; this does not imply weighting the likelihood.

levels.description: Calculate scale constants from each outcome-specific country-year subset while retaining that model’s same estimation records
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Fixed affine recodings preserve fitted predictors with the full lower-order basis. Scaling-source subset changes alone do not authorize changing the model sample; original coefficient scaling remains unidentified.

levels.description: Only OMREASON=2 is limited_options; mixed substantive code 3 is zero
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: The wording specifies no better choices; mixed classification is not stated.

levels.description: OMREASON in {2,3} counts limited-options motive
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Mixed code explicitly contains a work-choice component; including it changes the binary construct and is not proven equivalent.

levels.description: Expected future employees minus current employees >5
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Explicit method says more than five additional employees.

levels.description: Expected future total employees >5
levels.label: non_equivalent
levels.rationale: Later results omit additional, but this threshold measures future level instead of job growth.

levels.description: log(survey year minus first payment year) for resolved positive durations; unresolved cases left missing
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Matches log years definition without adding an unreported offset; handling of zero/censored dates is not given.

levels.description: log(1 + resolved years since first payment)
levels.label: non_equivalent
levels.rationale: Preserves same-year owners but changes the regressor nonlinearly; unlike employee count, the article never states a plus-one offset for business age.

levels.description: OMOWN=all versus part

levels.rationale: Directly matches ownership-share wording.

levels.description: OMOWNERS=1 versus more than one owner-manager
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Counts people both owning and managing; may miss nonmanaging co-owners, so equivalence cannot be assumed.

axes.decision: Fertility control in expanded-sample robustness model

levels.description: Omit fertility only in A3_M2, following its blank printed cell
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Closest table-described term list, but blank may be a reporting omission.

levels.description: Include fertility in A3_M2, following MAIN’s general controls description
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Competing documented reading; cannot silently resolve the discrepancy.

compatibility.crossing: S06 response-year restriction × early-year fixed effects/roster
compatibility.reason: Dropping unavailable-status years changes the sample and available time indicators; retain an explicit changed-sample model.

compatibility.crossing: S03 strict owner duration × business-age zero alternative
compatibility.reason: A duration-qualified owner subset may remove same-year owners by construction; the age-zero question then has a different support.
Use one consistent nascent definition in its own outcome and the total-outcome union; never count overlapping statuses twice.

compatibility.crossing: S12 basis changes × lower-order terms / interaction structure
compatibility.reason: Polynomial equivalence requires the full linear/quadratic basis and corresponding female interactions, identical records/weights and an appropriate parameter transformation. Do not compare raw coefficient values across bases.

compatibility.crossing: S13 changed centering/scaling × raw coefficient comparisons
compatibility.reason: Changing fixed macro scale constants is an invertible reparameterization with all lower-order terms/interactions retained and unchanged estimation records. It changes fixed-coefficient interpretation and requires mapping before target comparison; it does not itself change the random-effects design.

compatibility.crossing: S09 historical sparse series imputation × current annual ECEC series
compatibility.reason: These are different source/concept branches; do not apply old-vintage imputation to a different observed annual measure and call it a historical reconstruction.

compatibility.crossing: S18 weighted estimation × undefined multilevel weight scaling / covariance
compatibility.reason: Weight selection, level scaling and covariance method must form a documented valid estimator combination; not every software procedure accepts arbitrary survey weights.

compatibility.crossing: S19 fixed-effects branch × time-invariant or nearly invariant macro predictors
compatibility.reason: Country fixed effects absorb time-invariant macro main effects and alter identification; interactions can remain but target a different structure.
REML option here applies only to the linear business-size model; it is not a substitute estimator for the binary outcomes.
Only A3_M2 has the blank fertility cell; all other explicitly printed controls must remain as specified.

compatibility.crossing: Distinct growth outcomes / nascent outcome as if one exchangeable axis
compatibility.reason: These are separate claims and estimands with distinct windows, not interchangeable equivalent specifications.

notes: No Cartesian-product specification count is asserted: source-dependent choices and estimator compatibility matter.

Equivalent means an explicitly described operational choice or an algebraically justified parameterization, not matching published results. Uncertain labels do not assert all choices are equally credible.
Listed controls are fixed within the equivalent set. Prose-only alternative-control checks are described in wider_space, not silently substituted.
No direction, numerical target or model fit is used to select a level. The article does not state software defaults, exact p values or tails.
